entries.0b3ed472a53ba2e6: Fire Doors and Smoke Control Equipment
entries.17190e90a00c8c48: This business manufactures and sells, and performs installation work for, automatic fire alarm equipment, environmental monitoring systems, fire doors, smoke control equipment and other products. The company and Shanghai Nōmi Shōbō Setsubi Yūgen Kōsha manufacture and sell the products, and group companies in each region handle sales and construction. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥51,017 million, making this the largest business in the group.
